summary: Explains the subelements filter (2.7+), which pairs each object with each value of a sub-list (with skip_missing), and using it in a loop to set authorized SSH keys per user.
questions: How do I loop over each user's list of SSH keys?
What does the subelements filter do?
How do I iterate over nested lists inside a list of dicts?

answer_card.title: Looping over nested lists with subelements
answer_card.answer_md:
`subelements` produces `[object, subvalue]` pairs:

```jinja
{{ users | subelements('groups', skip_missing=True) }}
```

Example: set each user's authorized keys:

```yaml
- ansible.posix.authorized_key:
    user: "{{ item.0.name }}"
    key: "{{ lookup('file', item.1) }}"
  loop: "{{ users | subelements('authorized') }}"
```
